_comment: Two kinds of sources. 'feeds' are curated editorial RSS feeds (full or near-full text). 'topics' are turned into Google News RSS search queries automatically so you don't have to hand-create Google Alerts. Edit freely. Set 'enabled' false to mute a source without deleting it.

feeds.name: Economist - Business (headlines only, paywalled full text)
Economist - The World This Week (headlines only)
